N1.s: Využili ste všetkých %lld bezplatných cutlingov. Pokračujte v Cutlingu a po odomknutí sa tento cutling uloží.
N1.back: Used you-have all 5 free-of-charge cutlings(gen.pl). Continue(you-formal) in Cutling(loc) and after unlocking itself this cutling will-save.
N1.why: Opens with S3's exact sentence so the limit always sounds the same; 'Pokračujte' names the system's continue choice, and the reflexive 'sa uloží' promises the save without a 'we'.

N2.s: Využili ste všetkých %lld bezplatných cutlingov. Ďalšie uložíte po odomknutí v Cutlingu.
N2.back: Used you-have all 5 free-of-charge cutlings(gen.pl). Further-ones you-will-save after unlocking in Cutling(loc).
N2.why: Same first sentence as N1 and S3; 'v Cutlingu' points to the app without an imperative the Mac or older iOS cannot act on; 'Ďalšie' agrees with the plural cutlingy; 85 chars.

N3.why: 'Uložené' is the status word Slovak iOS shows after a save; masculine 'jeden' agrees with cutling without naming it, and 'zadarmo' echoes S1 and S29; 27 chars.

N4.why: Same 'Uložené' as N3, then S5's 'Využili ste X z Y', so 5 of 5 reads as full without a word like limit; the 'z' shape needs no plural agreement; 26 chars.

N5.s: Využili ste %lld z %lld. Odomknúť a uložiť
N5.back: Used you-have 5 of 5. Unlock and save
N5.why: Carries N4's pair on, then the bar's action as an infinitive the way Slovak buttons and K1 are written; 'a uložiť' says the item being saved is not lost; 36 chars.

N6.why: Same infinitive as S15 and M1, where the Share sheet usually puts its save verb; 8 chars.

N7.s: Využili ste všetkých %lld bezplatných cutlingov. Keď Cutling odomknete, tento sa uloží.
N7.back: Used you-have all 5 free-of-charge cutlings(gen.pl). When Cutling you-unlock, this-one itself will-save.
N7.why: Same first sentence as S3 and N1; 'tento' points at the cutling in the form below, and the reflexive keeps one maker from speaking as 'we'; 84 chars.

N8.s: Tento cutling na vás počká. Uloží sa, keď otvoríte Cutling a odomknete ho.
N8.back: This cutling for you will-wait. It-will-save itself, when you-open Cutling and you-unlock it.
N8.why: 'Na vás počká' is how a Slovak says something is kept for you, and it matches the waiting sixth tile in the sheet; 'ho' takes the nearest masculine, Cutling; 74 chars.
